vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope vBRIEF for interactive play and bedtime moments

narratives.Overview: Build the tactile, child-facing interactions inside routine steps, especially dressing with interchangeable clothing, the Otter Flop catching-and-bouncing minigame, the visual prayer moment, and the lullaby/tuck-in sequence.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: Dressing allows choosing from unlocked interchangeable clothing items for the current otter kid. FR-2: Otter Flop is a simple touch interaction where dad catches the otter kid and bounces them on the bed. FR-3: Prayer is represented visually with mommy and daddy otter and does not display spoken prayer text. FR-4: Lullaby uses built-in instrumental audio and still works as a silent visual sequence when muted. NFR-1: Interactions must remain simple enough for preschool coordination. NFR-2: Audio must be optional and never required for progress.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-4 and NFR-1 through NFR-2.
